correction_receipt.action: INVALIDATED; count/root from prior exploratory probe cannot be used for selection, evidence, or later parity
correction_receipt.last_clean_point: V220 frozen semantic contracts plus verified causal bar/indicator caches before full GA1
correction_receipt.prior_real_probe: one XAUUSD/BUY/M1 base, no-transform exploratory mask grouping exposed structural count only

mask_representation.collision_policy: stored exact mask bytes/deltas are compared; any same SHA256 with unequal exact coordinates fails closed
mask_representation.equivalence: source-record coordinates deterministically map 1:1 to V220 canonical_event_axis_id within fixed domain; coordinate equality is exact mask equality
mask_representation.scientific_identity: ordered exact canonical event-axis positions within fixed asset+side+timeframe domain

temporal_semantics.close_break_signal_time: exact right-edge civil time of completed breakout bar; canonical availability source-record index is first source record of next observed signal bar / next executable quote
temporal_semantics.close_reclaim_signal_time: exact right-edge civil time of the completed reclaim bar; canonical availability source-record index is first source record of next observed signal bar / next executable quote
temporal_semantics.mtf_gate: latest context bar whose completion_source_index is strictly less than final candidate availability_source_record_index
temporal_semantics.opposite_break_during_retest: same trigger semantic and same active BREAKOUT_BUFFER multiplier as the pending same-side breakout, applied to the opposite confirmed boundary; earliest opposite-break availability cancels pending retest
temporal_semantics.retest_window_close_break: breakout becomes available after the completed breakout bar; window_bars=1 is the immediately following signal bar; N includes that bar plus N-1 following bars
temporal_semantics.retest_window_tick_break: window_bars=1 includes the remaining causal portion of the breakout bar after the triggering tick; N includes breakout bar plus N-1 following signal bars
temporal_semantics.session_gate_close: evaluate on exact completed-bar right-edge civil time, not delayed first quote after close
temporal_semantics.session_gate_tick: evaluate on exact triggering/reclaim tick source-server civil time
temporal_semantics.touch_reclaim_signal_time: exact reclaiming tick source timestamp; canonical availability source-record index is reclaim tick index
